Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

Grab it by **28. March** free demonstration pose. It's perfect for displaying your collection of ancient treasures, your new C.A.M.P. or showcasing a recent victory over a pesky RAD cockroach.

With the owl in the cage, you can be sure that this month it won't suddenly be said that it has fledged.

*Because she never will*.
